name: 02771 · Seekonk, MA
findings: ZIP 02771 (Seekonk) has 50 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02771 (Seekonk) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02771 (Seekonk) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).
